propose.title: Suggest a place
propose.sendError: We couldn’t send your suggestion. Please try again.

s1.intro: Tell us about the place. The basics are enough; we’ll check the rest.
s1.name: Name of the place
s1.nameError: Enter the name of the place to continue.

s2.intro: What is a must-try? Add 1 to 3 dishes. It’s what helps people most to decide to go.
s2.photos: Photos are provided by the business itself, or used with its permission. You don’t need to upload any for now.

s3.intro: HeartEats brings together independent businesses whose team includes people with disabilities. Help us check it.
s3.how: How do you know the business?
s3.howHint: E.g.: I go often, I saw it in the news, I work there…
s3.linkError: Enter a valid link starting with https:// or leave it empty.
s3.indep: It’s an independent business (not a large chain)
s3.note: do not write names or health information about any person. If the business wants to tell its team’s story, it will do so itself, with each person’s consent.

s4.intro: In case we need to ask you something. It’s optional and never shown on the website.
s4.emailError: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
s4.consent: By sending, you agree that we review the suggestion and publish it if it meets the criteria of an independent business with an inclusive team.

done.title: Thanks for suggesting it!
done.body: We’ll review {name} and, if everything fits, you’ll see it on the map. If we need anything else, we’ll write to you (only if you left your email).

correct.title: Suggest a correction
correct.sendError: We couldn’t send your correction. Please try again.

s1.intro: Thanks for helping us keep the details up to date. First, tell us what isn’t right.
s1.question: What needs fixing?
s1.error: Choose what needs fixing to continue.

s2.intro: Tell us in your own words. If you have something that confirms it, it helps us check it sooner.
s2.details: What has changed or what is wrong?
s2.detailsError: Tell us what needs fixing to continue.

hints.address: E.g.: the correct address is … street, number …
hints.hours: E.g.: it now opens Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00.
hints.closed: E.g.: I saw it closed and the premises up for rent.
hints.team: E.g.: keep it general, without names or health information.
hints.other: Tell us what you have seen.

s2.linkError: Enter a valid link starting with https:// or leave it empty.
s2.note: do not write names or health information about any person, even if the correction is about the team.

s3.intro: In case we need to ask you something. It’s optional and never shown on the website.
s3.emailError: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
s3.consent: By sending, you agree that we review your report and update the listing if it is correct.

done.title: Thanks for letting us know!
done.body: We’ll review your report about {name} and, if it is correct, we’ll update the listing. If we need anything else, we’ll write to you (only if you left your email).

pick.title: Which place do you want to correct?
pick.body: Reports are sent from each place’s page: open it and press “Suggest a correction”.
